description: This file contains utility functions for interacting with Git repositories, detecting changed files, and managing extension packages within a project. It provides mechanisms to list available extensions, detect changed extensions based on Git diffs, and resolve Git revisions.

methods.name: runGit
methods.description: Executes a Git command with specified arguments within the repository root directory.

methods.name: normalizeRelative
methods.description: Converts a file path to a normalized form with forward slashes.

methods.name: hasGitCommit
methods.description: Checks if a given Git ref or commit hash exists locally.

methods.name: resolveChangedPathsBase
methods.description: Resolves the base revision for listing changed files, with fallback options.

methods.name: listChangedPaths
methods.description: Lists files changed between two Git revisions.

methods.name: hasExtensionPackage
methods.description: Determines if an extension package exists at a specified path.

methods.name: listAvailableExtensionIds
methods.description: Lists all extension IDs that have a package.json file, sorted.

methods.name: detectChangedExtensionIds
methods.description: Detects extension IDs that have changed based on a list of file paths.

methods.name: listChangedExtensionIds
methods.description: Lists changed extension IDs based on Git diff with fallback behavior.
